name: create-prd
tagline_zh: 写PRD总卡在空白页？八段模板从问题到发布，连价值主张都替你铺好，像有产品老手坐你旁边。
tagline_en: Stuck on a blank PRD? 8 sections from problem to launch, value props pre-wired—like a PM pro beside you.
desc_en: Create a Product Requirements Document using a comprehensive 8-section template covering problem, objectives, segments, value propositions, solution, and release planning. Use when writing a PRD, documenting product requirements, preparing a feature spec, or reviewing an existing PRD.
why_zh: 同类工具只给大纲，它连价值主张和发布计划都结构化，省去你从零拆解的脑力。
why_en: Others give outlines; this one structures value props and release plans, saving your brain from scratch.
